findings.summary: When a cited file name (bare or under a snapshot prefix) matches two or more same-named files in the change diff, the Where tag says 'outside the change' instead of 'unknown' or the agreed tag, and a 'pre-existing' note then moves a blocker on added lines out of Fix now without a caveat.
findings.recommended_fix: In whereInChange (build-report.mjs around line 638-640), when 2+ same-named diff files match, use the tag they all agree on, else return 'unknown' rather than 'outside the change'; keep 'outside the change' for names no diff file has. Treat 'unknown' like 'added lines' in the preOnAdded caveat (line 802) and groupFindings (line 1149). Apply to both skills' copies and update the two tests that assert the current output.

auditor_check.evidence: Called buildReport from the pair-review copy with a packet hypothesis ending 'Confirm it is fixed.' and both seats answering 'reload path still skips clear(). CONFIRMED.': without the definition sentence the row came out verdict 'refuted', outcomes REFUTED/REFUTED, fixWorded true; with the build-recheck-packet definition sentence added it came out 'confirmed'. The flip is decided only from packetText (line 700), while every current seat brief (review-protocol.md line 248) defines CONFIRMED as 'the defect it names exists' and tells seats to read a fix-worded hypothesis as its defect; task-packet-template.md has no line matching the regex. So a hand-written packet from the template, or a 1.1.0-drafted packet run on the current skill, shows a still-present defect as green REFUTED, and the printed caveat claims the opposite meaning. Trigger is narrower than a regenerated packet, so MEDIUM is kept.

findings.summary: The 'Confirm it is fixed' polarity flip is keyed on the packet text, not on the brief the seats received, so a current-run seat's defect-side CONFIRMED on a packet without the definition sentence is shown as a green REFUTED with a misleading caveat.
findings.recommended_fix: Decide fixWordedFlips (build-report.mjs line 700) from the run's own seat brief (phase1 brief text containing 'CONFIRMED (the defect it names exists)') or the run's skill version, flipping only when the brief lacks that definition; alternatively add the definition sentence to task-packet-template.md so hand-written packets match.
